scope: Publication privacy and path portability; this does not change source-content review status.

checks.text_and_binary_scan_scope: All publication candidate directories, including the active skill snapshot, excluding Git internals, local history, compiled caches, installed dependencies and publication scratch files.

publication_exclusions: local environment credentials and editor state
commit_identity: GitHub username and GitHub noreply email; personal global Git identity not used.
preserved_originals: Supplied original bytes, source identities, archive-member provenance, source locators and source semantic-review statuses are unchanged.
limits: Source publications and their extracted evidence retain publisher-origin staff names, work emails, template paths and internal server references. These are distinct from the local personal paths removed for this publication.
Pattern and metadata checks do not establish absence of every possible private datum. Not every image or PDF page was visually inspected or OCR-scanned for this publication.
Historical validation reports retain their original dates, results and pre-publication artifact hashes; their identifying path labels were made repository-relative.
Full diagram rendering and source business-semantic reviews were not rerun for this path-portability change.
